feeds.title: Restoring Vintage Bicycles from the Hand Built Era
feeds.description: Hi there. I am a lifelong rider and cycling enthusiast. I enjoy all kinds of bikes but especially have come to love hand-built steel classics built from the 30s through the 80s. I have focused on restoring French touring and randonneuring bikes and other classic lightweights.

feeds.title: Cicli Berlinetta Blog
feeds.description: An avid cyclist and keen collector Dustin Nordhus began trading in high end racing bicycles fifteen years ago. Together with his small team of staff, all avid cyclists, he has been positively influencing the vintage bike scene from his Berlin store, serving an ever widening fan base of discerning bike lovers and collectors from all over the world.

feeds.title: SDBICYCLEGARAGE.com Sexy Race Bicycles
feeds.description: Dedicated to Vintage Italian, French, Swiss, Japanese, and; American Racing Bicycles with Campagnolo, Campy, Mafac, Huret, Suntour components.

feeds.title: Velo Aficionado Blog
feeds.description: Bike blog about pro cycling, bicycle restoration, cycling history, bicycle technology. Detailed cycling insights for dedicated bike riders.

feeds.title: The Retrogrouch
feeds.description: A blog about bicycles and bicycle riding. Emphasis on vintage and classic bikes, with lots about old vs. new technology.

feeds.title: Dave Moulton's Blog
feeds.description: An ex-bicycle frame builder's personal thoughts on bike history, tech, bicycle culture and often just life in general. His bikes have been ridden in the Tour de France, Olympics, and World Championships.

feeds.title: The Simplicity of Vintage Cycles
feeds.description: Stories and Blog posts on vintage bicycle restoration based in Corvallis, Oregon. Josh Capps is a Vintage bicycle restorationist, collector and rider.

feeds.title: The Spoken
feeds.description: Cycle EXIF is a celebration of the beauty and diversity of the bicycle. It's an online gallery of its many forms and facets, ranging from modern and classic road bikes, MTBs, BMXs, to graveleurs, porteurs, tourers, and randonneurs.
